query: SELECT cm.title, cm.slug, COUNT(cl.id) as lesson_count FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title, cm.slug ORDER BY cm.orderIndex;
